resources.string: They leave your contact lists, search, widgets and other apps. They also leave the account they\'re saved in, such as Google, so your other phones and computers lose them too. Parley still names their calls and finds them when you search everything. Old calls in Android\'s call log may still show the name. You can bring them back from Contacts › ⋮ › Archived.

resources.string: They leave your contact lists, search, widgets and other apps. Saved contacts also leave the account they\'re in, such as Google, so your other phones and computers lose them too. Private ones stay private. Parley still names their calls. Old calls in Android\'s call log may still show the names. You can bring them back from Contacts › ⋮ › Archived.
Couldn\'t archive these contacts. Nothing changed.

They leave your contact lists and search, and stay private: kept only in Parley, behind your private-contacts lock. Parley still names their calls as it does for private contacts. You can bring them back from Contacts › ⋮ › Archived.
